# Respondly

> Respondly is an AI agent that replies to new Google reviews automatically for local businesses. Owners connect their Google Business Profile, set a rule for each star rating, and every evening (Sydney time) Respondly posts replies using their own templates or AI that reads what the customer wrote.

- Prices are in AUD. Works for any business with a Google Business Profile.
- Starter (A$9.99/month): one template per star rating, filled in with the customer's name and the business's details.
- Pro (A$19.99/month): AI replies written from each review, in the reviewer's language, following the owner's tone and instructions.
- Every plan starts with a 90-day free trial. Cancel any time.
- Approve-first mode: any rule can keep replies as drafts until the owner publishes them.
- Only reviews posted after connecting are answered automatically. Old reviews are left alone.
- Respondly uses Google's official Business Profile API, and access can be disconnected at any time.
